settings.editor: Top Notch Painting is the painting and finishing division of Top Notch Logworks, employee owned and based in Gypsum, Colorado.

background_image.alt: Top Notch crew working on a log home

settings.editor:
Top Notch Logworks has been building some of the largest log and timber homes and resorts in the Aspen and Vail valleys since 1999. That experience gave us a deep understanding of how mountain homes are built, how they move, and what high altitude, dry air and intense sun do to a finish.

Top Notch Painting grew out of that work. Our management team has more than 100 years of combined experience in the log and timber industry, and our office and production yard are in Gypsum, at 4722 Hwy US-6.

background_image.alt: Crew media blasting a log wall

settings.editor:
We're an employee-owned company. That helps us keep skilled people, the ones with the know-how to make a finish last, and it means the person working on your home has a stake in doing it right.

Our goal is to transform the experience of everyone who deals with us: clients, employees and vendors alike. We believe ethical practice and strong partnerships matter as much as quality work.

We match employee donations to charities up to $500 per employee each year. Through our Dollars for Doers program, when an employee or their family gives 30 or more volunteer hours to a nonprofit in a year, we donate $500 to that organization. We encourage local causes that make our own communities better.
Free written estimates across the Vail, Roaring Fork and Eagle valleys. We'll call within one business day to set up a walkthrough.
